report.headline: Requested POE50 for NSW1 half-hour 2026-08-06 17:00 AEST–2026-08-06 17:30 AEST is not provably public as of 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z; the forecast-vs-actual comparison over the review window shows MAE = 99.3 MW.
summary: I could not supply the POE50 from the specific forecast run asked for (the last run issued before 2026-08-06 17:00 AEST / 2026-08-06T07:00:00Z) because that run was not provably public by 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z (as requested in the investigation context).

The actual operational demand for the half-hour 2026-08-06 17:00 AEST–2026-08-06 17:30 AEST (2026-08-06T07:00:00Z–2026-08-06T07:30:00Z) was not provably public by 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z, so I cannot report the observed MW for that interval.

The forecast-vs-actual comparison (latest_available_as_of 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z) reports mean absolute error (MAE) = 99.3 MW (evidence_id: ev0631) and mean error = 35.9 MW (evidence_id: ev0632) for the review window.

possible_explanations.statement: The specific forecast run requested may not have been provably public by 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z because AEMO publication / file-availability timing can delay when a run becomes public.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Re-run get_forecast_runs with a later as_of_utc than 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z and check whether the requested run appears and its published_at_utc / available_at_utc fields are present.

possible_explanations.statement: The actual operational demand for 2026-08-06 17:00 AEST–2026-08-06 17:30 AEST might not have been published by AEMO by 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z (it was reported as not provably public in the tool outputs).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Re-run get_actual_demand with a later as_of_utc than 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z and check whether the interval 2026-08-06T07:00:00Z–2026-08-06T07:30:00Z becomes provably public (and obtain its actual_mw evidence_id).
